p1.description: We define goals, offer, audience, and competitors. Duration depends on services and available materials (texts, photos, pricing).

p2.name: Design
p2.description: Wireframes + design. Landing pages are faster; complex multi-page structures take longer. Faster with brand guidelines and references.

p3.name: Development
p3.description: Build and implementation. Landing page: 5–10 days; multi-page site: 10–15; site + integrations/CRM/bot: up to 20.

p4.name: Testing
p4.description: Devices, speed, SEO basics, and lead flows. Longer with many integrations or custom lead scenarios.

p5.name: Launch
p5.description: Deploy, domain/SSL, analytics, and handover. Duration depends on access to hosting/domain and tracking requirements.
